summaryJa: 482ATKSによるISR任務（Operation INHERENT RESOLVE）。機体はOKASから011206ZDEC22に離陸し、020723ZDEC22に着陸。総ミッション時間19時間17分。1323Z〜0626Zにエアハンドラー経由でSIGINTを収集し、011518Z〜020426Zにオンステーションでターゲット開発／HVI・POI／POLスキャン等のISR任務を実施。1620Zにバグダッド付近IVOで西→東に移動する可能性のあるUAPを1機観測したが追跡は行わず任務を継続。FMVはDGS‑ARで解析。事前調整236分、効果は「SATISFACTORY」。
summaryEn: ISR mission by 482ATKS (Operation INHERENT RESOLVE). Aircraft took off from OKAS at 011206ZDEC22 and landed at 020723ZDEC22; total mission time 19h17m. Collected SIGINT via airhandler from 1323Z–0626Z and conducted on‑station ISR/target development including HVI/POI and POL scans from 011518Z–020426Z. At 1620Z over IVO Baghdad a single possible UAP/UAV was observed moving west to east; it was not pursued and the mission continued. FMV was exploited by DGS‑AR. Precoord 236 minutes, assessed as satisfactory.
